IAEA Ministerial Conference in Incheon, Republic of Korea to Discuss the Role of Nuclear Power
alerts.summary: Media are invited to attend the IAEA International Ministerial Conference on Nuclear Power , which will take place from 27 to 29 October in Incheon, Republic of Korea. Journalists may also monitor the national statements and panel sessions via live video streaming on the  conference website in Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian and Spanish.
